# Ideas become clearer when they become **working artifacts.**

My projects range from research tooling and multimodal interfaces to algorithms, quantitative decision support, and civic technology. Each one is an attempt to make a difficult idea inspectable through software.

<div class="catalog-top"><span>01 / RESEARCH TOOL</span><span>PYTHON</span></div>

## [NoveltyAudit](https://github.com/niansia/NoveltyAudit)

An evidence-first agent skill for adversarial scholarly novelty audits. The workflow decomposes a claim, searches for a minimal set of earlier work, applies historical cutoffs, and makes bridge-dependent arguments explicit.

**Built around:** scholarly search, research integrity, AI agents, auditable evidence

[Explore the repository ↗](https://github.com/niansia/NoveltyAudit){.project-link}
:::

<div class="catalog-top"><span>02 / INTERACTIVE SYSTEM</span><span>JAVASCRIPT · C#</span></div>

## [Fusion OS](https://github.com/niansia/1113354_Windowsfinal)

A desktop-like environment that brings together more than 25 interactive applications behind a C# / WebView2 shell and a React + TypeScript interface.

**Built around:** multimodal interaction, AI prototypes, application integration
:::

::: {.catalog-card}
<div class="catalog-top"><span>03 / EDUCATION</span><span>JAVASCRIPT · PYTHON</span></div>

## [CSIE Algorithm Lab](https://github.com/niansia/CSIE_WEB)

An interactive collection of algorithm implementations and visual learning tools spanning dynamic programming, graph algorithms, optimization, and data structures.

**Built around:** explainable computation, visualization, algorithmic thinking
:::

::: {.catalog-card}
<div class="catalog-top"><span>04 / DECISION SUPPORT</span><span>C# · .NET</span></div>

## [Mortgage Decision Support](https://github.com/niansia/1113354_MortgageCalculator)

A financial decision tool with Monte Carlo stress testing, scenario comparison, risk metrics, and privacy-oriented verification concepts.

**Built around:** quantitative modeling, uncertainty, scenario simulation
:::

::: {.catalog-card}

A full-stack prototype for disaster requests, volunteer coordination, and persistent resource data.

**Built around:** service design, coordination, durable local data
